summary: SessionBoard's participant (speaker/submitter/exhibitor) experience centers on a per-event portal. A submitter fills a public submission form, can save a draft (needs at least a Title; banner marks draft mode; resume prompt on return; 'Reset saved data' discards), and submits. The confirmation email carries a portal link; new users create a password, click 'Continue to portal', and choose a portal. The dashboard shows branded (logo, accent color, welcome message) widgets: My Sessions/My Submissions, Invited Sessions (unanswered invitations), Confirmed Participation (accepted), Tasks, Files, Resources, with top-nav Submissions/Files/Resources. Speakers view/edit their submission via a session sidebar 'View Submission' button until the submission close date, after which editing locks. Tasks list name, required asterisk, description, due date+timezone, Incomplete/Complete status; detail view offers 'Open Link' and 'Mark as Complete'. Speakers upload session files (drag-drop/browse) typed as Presentation/Poster/Handout, version them with history, and exchange comments with admins. They download organizer-shared files, read wiki pages under Resources, change account email in Account Settings, switch portals (top-right 'Switch Portals') and events (top-left dropdown), and share group (exhibitor/sponsor) portal access via the admin. Headshots feed the agenda, program site, and embeds.
personas: Speaker/submitter (portal user): submits proposals, edits submissions, accepts invitations, completes tasks, uploads content
Speaker assistant: logs into portals on behalf of a speaker to complete tasks
Exhibitor/sponsor group member: shares a group portal with teammates, each with own credentials
Event admin/organizer (counterpart): configures portals, sends portal links, receives uploads/comments

features.name: Portal login and account creation
features.description: Participants reach the portal via a link in the submission confirmation email. New users are prompted to create a password; returning users enter theirs, click 'Continue to portal', then choose from the portals they can access. 'Forgot your password?' (bottom right of login box) sends a reset email from no-reply@sessionboard.com. Wrong-email login errors are resolved by the event team.
features.ui_expectations: Login page with email + password fields, forgot-password link at bottom right, 'Continue to portal' button, then a portal-picker list when the user has multiple portals

features.name: Participant dashboard with widgets
features.description: Branded per-event home (welcome message, accent color, logo, background image) with section widgets: My Sessions/My Submissions, Invited Sessions, Confirmed Participation (when participant acceptance is on), Tasks, Files, Resources. Top navigation includes Submissions, Files, Resources. Admin controls which sections and profile fields show (Show/Hide Fields; view-only locks).
features.ui_expectations: Dashboard of labeled widgets/cards; top nav bar; event branding; initials avatar menu top right; event switcher top left

features.name: View and edit submission
features.description: From the My Sessions widget, clicking a session opens a sidebar; 'View Submission' at the bottom opens the original form pre-populated and editable. Editing is allowed any time before the submission close date; after it passes, editing is disabled and changes require the event team.
features.ui_expectations: Session sidebar with 'View Submission' button; editable multi-page form; read-only/locked state after deadline

features.name: Save submission as draft
features.description: On the public submission form, entering at least a Title enables 'Save as draft' (bottom right). A banner marks the form as a draft. Returning users are prompted to resume the draft; 'Reset saved data' discards it. Advancing pages still requires all required fields.
features.ui_expectations: 'Save as draft' button bottom right, draft banner at form top, resume-draft prompt on return, 'Reset saved data' control

features.name: Accept/decline session participation
features.description: When participant acceptance is enabled, speakers see 'Invited Sessions' (invited, not yet answered) and can accept or decline participation per accepted session in the portal; accepted ones move to 'Confirmed Participation'. Exact accept/decline button labels not documented (inferred from category norms, e.g. Sessionize).
features.ui_expectations: Invited Sessions list with per-session accept/decline actions; Confirmed Participation list of accepted sessions

features.name: Portal task list and completion
features.description: Task list shows task name (e.g. 'Read T&C'), red asterisk for required, description, due date with timezone, and status Incomplete/Complete. Clicking expands full view with deadline status 'Open', full description, 'Open Link' when the team attached an external link, 'Mark as Complete' to finish, and 'Done' to exit without changing status. Tasks may be visible only to accepted speakers unless 'Always Show Tasks' is enabled. Task types include reading terms, external links, confirmations, file requests, and forms (headshot/bio questionnaires).
features.ui_expectations: Task list widget with required asterisks, due dates, status chips; expandable task detail with Open Link, Mark as Complete, Done buttons

features.name: Upload files to a session with versioning
features.description: Via top-nav Submissions > select session > 'Files' button beneath the session name; drag-and-drop or browse to upload. Files are designated 'Presentation', 'Poster', or 'Handout'. A new upload can be marked as a new version of a previous file; all versions stay downloadable via History/Expand All. Max file size documented in FAQ (limit not stated in article).
features.ui_expectations: Files panel per session with drag-drop zone, browse button, file-type selector, version history expander

features.name: Comments on session content
features.description: Participants view and post comments on their session content to communicate directly with event admins, via 'Expand All' or the 'Comment' button next to files/content.
features.ui_expectations: Comment thread attached to session files/content with a compose box; existing admin comments readable

features.name: View and download organizer-shared files
features.description: Click 'Files' at the top of the portal, then select a file from the Files widget to view or download materials the event team shared.
features.ui_expectations: Files area/widget listing shared files; clicking opens or downloads

features.name: Resources and wiki pages
features.description: Click 'Resources' at the top of the portal; the Resources widget lists organizer-assigned items including downloadable documents and wiki pages that render as readable pages.
features.ui_expectations: Resources button/tab; widget listing wiki pages; wiki page renders formatted content

features.name: Account settings and profile editing
features.description: Click the square with your initials (top right) > 'Account Settings'; edit the 'Email Address' field and press the green 'SAVE CHANGES' button — new email becomes the login. Portals also let users view/edit profile information (bio, headshot, etc.) subject to admin Show/Hide Fields settings (fields can be editable, view-only, or hidden).
features.ui_expectations: Avatar/initials menu with Account Settings; email field; SAVE CHANGES button; profile fields respecting visibility settings

features.name: Add or edit session speakers on accepted session
features.description: For accepted sessions, speakers add/edit speaker information via 'View Submission' or a dedicated portal task asking to add speakers; if neither is visible the feature isn't enabled and users must contact the event admin. Detailed steps not rendered in docs; add/remove co-speaker mechanics inferred from category norms.
features.ui_expectations: Within View Submission or a task: speaker section with fields per speaker and add-speaker control (inferred)

features.name: Multi-portal and multi-event switching
features.description: Name menu (top right) > 'Switch Portals' switches among user/group portals (speakers with group portals, sponsor affiliates, speaker assistants) to view and complete each portal's tasks. Down arrow/event name at top left lists other events tied to the same email, alphabetically sorted; different credentials require re-login.
features.ui_expectations: 'Switch Portals' entry in top-right name dropdown; top-left event-name dropdown listing events alphabetically

features.name: Shared group (exhibitor/sponsor) portals
features.description: Exhibitors/sponsors are 'groups'; multiple teammates access the same group portal with individual credentials and see identical info. Colleagues are added by the event admin (given first name, last name, email); each receives a portal login link and creates their own password, then can complete group tasks.
features.ui_expectations: Group portal identical for all members; per-member logins; group tasks completable by any member

features.name: Speaker headshot upload and guidelines
features.description: Headshot appears on the event agenda, program site, and speaker embeds. Guidance: face camera and smile naturally, well-lit photo, neutral background; avoid uneven lighting, multiple people, busy backgrounds. Collected via profile fields or a headshot/bio form task (upload location inferred); size specs live in a separate FAQ.
features.ui_expectations: Headshot image field on profile or a form task with image upload preview (inferred)

In the session view/sidebar, click 'View Submission' (or equivalent)

Change the abstract text, save, reload, reopen the submission
Verify the edited text persisted

Open the submission via View Submission
Verify the form is read-only or shows an editing-closed message

rubric.criterion: Public submission form supports save-as-draft with title only, draft banner, resume, and discard
auto_steps: Open the public submission form for the seeded open call
Enter only a Title and click 'Save as draft' (or equivalent)
Verify a draft indicator/banner appears
Close and reopen the form (same identity); verify a resume-draft prompt or restored data
Use 'Reset saved data'/discard and verify the draft is cleared
rubric.pass_criteria: Draft saves with minimal data, restores on return, and can be discarded; required fields still gate page progression
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of draft banner, resume prompt, and cleared form after reset

rubric.criterion: Speaker can accept or decline a session invitation and the session moves to confirmed
auto_steps: Log in as speaker seeded with one pending session invitation
Verify an Invited Sessions (or equivalent) area lists the invitation with accept/decline actions
Accept the invitation
Verify the session now appears under Confirmed Participation (or equivalent) and leaves the invited list
Reload and verify state persists
rubric.pass_criteria: Accept action transitions the session from invited to confirmed persistently; decline path removes/marks it declined
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of invited list before, confirmation dialog/action, and confirmed list after

rubric.criterion: Task list shows name, required indicator, due date, and Incomplete/Complete status; detail view opens
auto_steps: Log in as speaker seeded with 3 tasks (one required, one with external link, one complete)
Verify list rows show task name, a required marker on the required task, due dates, and per-task status
Click the required task and verify an expanded view with full description and due date/status
rubric.pass_criteria: All listed metadata renders per task; clicking opens a detail view
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of task list and of one expanded task

rubric.criterion: Tasks can be marked complete (persisting), exited without change, and expose attached external links
auto_steps: Open the external-link task; verify an 'Open Link' (or equivalent) control targeting the seeded URL
Open an incomplete task and click 'Done'/close without completing; verify status stays Incomplete
Reopen it and click 'Mark as Complete'
Verify status changes to Complete in the list and persists after reload
rubric.pass_criteria: Completion is explicit, persistent, and distinct from merely closing the task; external link control present and correct
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of status before/after completion and of the Open Link control

rubric.criterion: Speaker can upload a file to their session and classify it (Presentation/Poster/Handout)

Upload a small .pptx or .pdf via browse or drag-drop
Set its type to 'Presentation' (or equivalent category)
Verify the file appears listed with name and type; reload and verify persistence
rubric.pass_criteria: Upload succeeds, file is listed with its designated category, and persists
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of upload UI and of listed file with category

rubric.criterion: File versioning: a new upload can be marked as a new version, with history of prior versions
auto_steps: In the session Files area, upload a second file and mark it as a new version of the PRT-10 file
Expand History/Expand All (or equivalent)
Verify both versions are listed and individually accessible
rubric.pass_criteria: Versions are linked to one logical file; all versions remain viewable/downloadable
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of version history showing v1 and v2

rubric.criterion: Speaker can read and post comments on session content to communicate with admins
auto_steps: In the session Files/content area, open comments via Comment/Expand All (or equivalent)
Verify a seeded admin comment is readable
Post a reply and verify it appears in the thread and persists after reload
rubric.pass_criteria: Comment thread readable and writable from participant side. Unverified: admin-side receipt/notification of the new comment (needs second account)
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of thread showing seeded admin comment and posted reply

rubric.criterion: Organizer-shared files are listed in a portal Files area and can be opened/downloaded
auto_steps: Click 'Files' in the portal top navigation
Verify the seeded organizer file (e.g. 'Speaker Guide.pdf') is listed
Click it and verify a view or download is initiated
rubric.pass_criteria: Shared file listed and click triggers open/download. Unverified: integrity of the downloaded file content (manual check of the downloaded file if required)
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of Files widget and of the triggered open/download

rubric.criterion: Resources area lists wiki pages that open as readable formatted content
auto_steps: Click 'Resources' at the top of the portal
Verify the seeded wiki page (e.g. 'Event FAQ') is listed in the Resources widget
Open it and verify formatted content renders
rubric.pass_criteria: Wiki page discoverable under Resources and renders its content
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of Resources list and rendered wiki page

rubric.criterion: Account settings reachable from the avatar menu allow changing the login email with persistence
auto_steps: Click the initials/avatar menu top right and select Account Settings (or equivalent)
Edit the Email Address field to a new value and click SAVE CHANGES (or equivalent)
Verify a success state and that the field shows the new value after reload
Log out and log back in with the new email
rubric.pass_criteria: Email updates persist and become the login credential. Unverified: any email confirmation message sent to old/new address
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of settings form before/after save; successful re-login with new email

rubric.criterion: User associated with multiple portals/events can switch between them from the header
auto_steps: Log in as seeded user tied to two portals (e.g. speaker portal + sponsor group portal)
Open the name menu top right and select 'Switch Portals' (or use the top-left event/portal dropdown)
Switch to the second portal
Verify the dashboard content changes to the second portal's tasks/branding
rubric.pass_criteria: Switcher lists both portals and switching swaps context without re-login
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of switcher menu and of both portal dashboards

sample_data: Event 'DevConf 2026' with open call (close date +30d) and event 'MedTech Summit 2026' with closed call (close date -7d). Speaker account jane.speaker@example.com / Passw0rd! tied to both events plus a sponsor group portal 'Acme Corp' (for switch-portals test). Seed: one submission 'Scaling LLM Inference in Production' (abstract, track 'AI/ML', format 'Breakout', status Accepted) on DevConf; one past-deadline submission on MedTech; one pending session invitation 'AI Ethics Panel, Sat 10:00 AM' (participant acceptance enabled); 3 tasks — 'Sign speaker agreement' (required, due +14d 11:59 PM ET, Incomplete), 'Register for the event' (external link https://example.com/register, Incomplete), 'Read T&C' (Complete); organizer-shared file 'Speaker Guide.pdf'; wiki page 'Event FAQ' with formatted text; one seeded admin comment on session files ('Please use the event slide template'); local upload fixtures keynote-v1.pptx and keynote-v2.pptx (small); headshot.jpg for profile. Group portal has second member bob.assistant@example.com to validate shared group access.
gaps: The 'Add or edit session speakers' article body never rendered (2 fetch attempts returned nav shell); only its access-requirement note was recovered — co-speaker add/edit/remove mechanics are inferred from category norms. Exact accept/decline button labels for invitations are undocumented (widget names 'Invited Sessions'/'Confirmed Participation' come from the Portals 101 admin guide). Max upload file size and recommended headshot dimensions live in FAQ articles not fetched. Headshot upload location (profile field vs form task) inferred. Task reminder/notification emails and post-acceptance notification flows are not covered in the participant guide (inferred as standard). No screenshots were extractable, so pixel-level layout (widget order, sidebar composition) is approximate. Attendee-facing experience is out of scope of these docs — participant here means speaker/submitter/exhibitor/sponsor.
